pasos.descripcion:
Type your idea in the top field. It can be simple ('a cat') or detailed ('a golden Persian cat sleeping on a blue velvet sofa in warm sunset light').

💡 The more specific, the better the result. Include: subject, action, setting, style.

Switch with Alt+1 (Image), Alt+2 (Video), Alt+3 (Audio) or the top selector.

• Image: photos, illustrations, art
• Video: clips, animations, motion graphics
• Audio: songs, music, effects

Each mode has specific models and different settings.

Pick the model from the dropdown. The most popular ones:

• FLUX — excellent for anything, fast
• Midjourney — artistic style, vibrant colors
• Kling / Seedance — for realistic video
• Suno — for music and audio
• Stable Diffusion — full control, technical

Each model has a different 'personality'. Experiment.

Choose the target platform: SeaArt, Tensor.Art, ComfyUI, Kling, Suno, etc.

This adapts the prompt format: some use weighted tags, others natural language. The platform also affects which models are available.

Check 1-3 styles you want to apply. Options:

• Realistic Photography • Cinema • Anime/Manga
• Digital Art • Concept Art • Illustration
• Vintage • Cyberpunk • Fantasy • Horror

💡 Combining more than 3 can produce unexpected results. Less is more.

Choose the format based on the destination:

• 1:1 — Square (Instagram posts)
• 16:9 — Horizontal (YouTube, web)
• 9:16 — Vertical (Stories, Reels, TikTok)
• 4:3 — Classic (photography)
• 21:9 — Ultra wide (cinematic)

The ratio affects composition and focus. A 9:16 forces a close-up; 16:9 allows more context.

If you generate the same character often, save it here.

Define: name, physical description, distinctive traits, usual clothing.

When you activate a character, its description is added to the prompt automatically. Ideal for series, comics, stories.

LoRAs are small models that add specific styles or subjects.

Activate them from the LoRA panel. Some popular ones:
• Artistic styles (anime, watercolor)
• Effects (glow, glitch)
• Specific subjects (characters, objects)

💡 Each LoRA consumes part of the prompt 'budget'.

pasos.titulo: 🛡️ 9. NEGATIVE — What you do NOT want
pasos.descripcion:
The negative prompt states what should NOT appear in the image.

Typical negatives: low quality, blurry, distorted, ugly, deformed, watermark, text.

Use '🛡 Generate optimal negative' for an automatic one based on your model.

Press Ctrl+Enter or the '✨ Generate' button.

The LLM takes your idea + configuration and creates an optimized prompt.

Options:
• Ctrl+Enter = Full generate (8-15s)
• Alt+Enter = Quick Generate (3-6s, less elaborate)

If you don't like the result, use Refine:

• Standard refine — general improvement
• Refine more cinematic — epic framing, dramatic camera
• Refine more facial detail — eyes, skin, textures
• Refine better lighting — lights, shadows, atmosphere
• Refine simplify — removes redundancies

💡 Try Refine first before regenerating from scratch.

Scoring analyzes your prompt and proposes automatic improvements.

Use '📊 Auto scoring' in macros to apply directly, or normal scoring to see the comparison.

Scoring detects: technical quality, balance, coherence, detail.

Save what you like to reuse it:

• Ctrl+S = Favorite (quick access)
• Ctrl+Shift+S = Star (premium highlight)

Favorites appear in the side panel. Stars are your best work.

Templates with professional structures. Access: Templates menu.

Categories: Portraits, Landscapes, Cinema, Fashion, Anime, Product, Architecture, Gaming, Art, Photo.

💡 Replace the variables {subject}, {place}, {time_of_day}, etc. with your data.

Create sequences that run automatically:

1. Save your favorite actions as a macro
2. Add steps: Generate → Refine → Scoring → Save
3. Run everything in one click

Use the predefined macros or create your own. Ideal for repetitive workflows.

Save configurations: model + platform + ratio + styles.

Use when you have a combination that works well and want to recall it quickly.

Difference from templates: Seeds save only config, templates save the full setup.

Generate 4 versions with different variations:

• Change only style → compare aesthetics
• Change only lighting → compare mood
• Change ratio → compare composition
• Combine changes → find the optimum

Select 1-2 dimensions to vary. The 4 options are shown in a grid to compare.

Activate from the 🎬 button in the bar.

Records: prompts, clicks, errors, complete flows.

Then you can:
• Export as a step-by-step tutorial
• Review what you did wrong
• Create documentation of your process

Recording options: app only, full screen, or text only.

Each time you generate/refine, a version is saved (up to 30).

Access from '📜 Prompt versions' in the menu.

Useful for:
• Comparing previous versions
• Recovering one that was better
• Seeing the evolution of your prompt

Ctrl+F opens global search in:

• History — all generated prompts
• Favorites — your quick saves
• Stars — your best work

Search by keywords in the content.

The most useful ones:

• Ctrl+Enter — Generate prompt
• Ctrl+S — Save favorite
• Ctrl+Shift+S — Save star
• Ctrl+I — Creative ideas
• Ctrl+F — Global search
• Ctrl+T — This tutorial
• Ctrl+L — Open LoRAs
• Ctrl+P — Character group
• Ctrl+Shift+N — Negative builder
• Ctrl+Shift+P — Preview
• F11 — Full screen
• Alt+1/2/3 — Switch mode

From the Export menu, you can:

• Copy to clipboard
• Save as .txt / .json
• Export for CLI (ComfyUI, A1111)
• Export the full project

The format depends on the destination: tags, natural, JSON.

In the extra settings panel:

• Weight (1-30) — LoRA intensity
• Seed — Reproducibility
• Repeats — Repeat elements
• CFG Scale — Fidelity to the prompt
• Steps — Quality vs speed

💡 These significantly affect the result. Experiment carefully.

Access from '📈 Statistics' in Analytics.

Shows:
• Prompts generated
• Most used models
• Favorite styles
• Usage time

Useful to understand your workflow and optimize it.

Load an image and extract its 'DNA': subject, lighting, style, camera, composition.

Then you can:
• Convert to a structured prompt
• Keep some elements (e.g. style) and change others
• Save the DNA to reuse

Powerful for analysis and controlled variations.

1. Be specific in the idea — 'cat' vs 'golden Persian cat sleeping'
2. Limit styles to 2-3 — more creates chaos
3. Use negatives — avoid what you don't want
4. Try variations — A/B testing is your friend
5. Save the good ones — favorites and stars
6. Iteration > Regenerate — refine before starting over
7. Experiment — the best prompts come from testing

🎓 With practice you'll master all the tools. Good luck!

Quick (⚡ or Alt+Enter) generates a prompt in ONE pass, without the analysis phases — ideal when you already know what you want.

🔄 Variations (Ctrl+Shift+Enter) creates 3 different versions of the same idea so you can pick the best.

Iterate generates N versions changing a SINGLE element (camera, light, style…) to compare while keeping everything else equal.

Pulse adds intensity/energy to a prompt. Suggest proposes concrete improvements you apply with one click.

The Copilot opens a dialog about your prompt: ask it for changes in natural language ('darker', 'add fog') and it rewrites it respecting the model's format.

💡 Perfect for fine adjustments without regenerating from scratch.

pasos.titulo: 🎯 30. LOOP OPTIMIZER — Improve until the target
pasos.descripcion:
Different from one-off Scoring: the Optimizer (📊 Analytics menu) repeats generate→score→improve until it reaches the score you set (or runs out of N iterations), and ALWAYS keeps the best version seen.

💡 Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+O. It scores and improves taking the active model into account.

pasos.titulo: 🎯 31. ADAPT TO ACTIVE MODEL — One click to the right format
pasos.descripcion:
Rewrites the current prompt to the EXACT format of the selected model: natural vs tags, use (or not) of weights, character limit and negatives.

Available in the 🛠 Tools menu and as a Macro step. 💡 It doesn't change your idea, only its form.

Four narrative generators:
• Mood — explores tone and atmosphere.
• Story — a sequence with beginning, middle and end.
• Board — a board of related scenes.
• Walk — a spatial tour through an environment.

Generate N panels (3-12) with shot type (CLOSE-UP, WIDE, POV…) and a description per panel, keeping visual coherence between them.

💡 IMAGE mode only. Shortcut Ctrl+Shift+B. The '📋 Merge' button combines them into a single multi-panel prompt.

Converts the current image prompt into a VIDEO prompt ready for Veo/Sora/Kling/Seedance, adding camera movement, duration and shots.

💡 The 'Shots' selector calibrates the number of shots based on the chosen duration.

Img→Prompt uploads an image and extracts a prompt that describes it.

With the 🖼 Ref switch on, instead of copying the literal image it extracts only its visual GUIDANCE (palette, light, style) to create a NEW scene with that aesthetic.

After generating variations, the Comparator shows them side by side with buttons to use or copy each one.

👁 Pollinations Grid (Ctrl+G inside the window) generates a real preview of ALL of them at once so you can choose with the image in front of you.

The 🖼 Preview button (Ctrl+Shift+P) generates a sketch of the prompt via Pollinations to give you an idea BEFORE taking it to your final platform.

💡 It's cached: the same prompt is not generated again.

Generates a complete dataset to train a character LoRA: up to 24 angles with the SAME identity, kohya-style captions and official SeaArt tips.

It can start from a text sheet, an automatic sheet (🎲) or a reference photo (📷, img2img edit mode).

Client Mode turns a professional brief into 5 different prompt proposals.

Detect style (3 images) analyzes a moodboard and extracts its common aesthetic to apply to your next prompts.

💰 Session cost (📊 Analytics, Ctrl+Shift+M) shows spending per provider and per model, the total and the history.

🧠 Next to the brain you can choose the exact model (Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek…); each has its own price and is remembered between sessions.

🏠 Dashboard (Ctrl+Shift+D) is your control panel: statistics, activity from recent days, achievements and the challenge of the day.

📁 Projects groups prompts and their setup by job, so you don't mix up different campaigns.

More tools worth knowing:
• 🧰 Negative builder (Ctrl+Shift+N) · 📐 Formulas · 🏷 Snippets / Quick expansion
• 🎯 Focus mode (Ctrl+H) · ⚡ Brief mode · 💡 Clarity suggestions (Ctrl+Shift+C)
• ⏰ Cron prompts · 👥 Character group (Ctrl+P)
